qualitative_review: At least four visibly distinct scales: silicon/room, city, planet/orbit, cosmos/meta-space.
Renderer changes must feel like a coherent visual grammar rather than a demo reel.
Message typography must emerge from scene events and remain readable at 360px.
Probe launch/contact must read as real travel and consequence at normal speed.
No consecutive camera family repetition unless explicitly justified in assistant review.
Ending must resolve the story before presenting the thesis.
